head: 0bed3ce4
gate: Stable HTTP/1 pull body reader with content decoding, HTTP/2 pull nextBody and concurrent stream serving aliases, HTTP/3 cumulative max_body_bytes for server requests and client response/push bodies

commands.http3_body_bound: zig build test-lib -Dtest-filter="HTTP/3 incremental reader" --summary all

notes: The HTTP/1 pull BodyReader drives the existing push parser through a bounded FIFO producer. Tests cover a 200 KiB body with 100-continue and keep-alive, chunked trailers, cancellation closing an unread connection, max_body_bytes rejection, non-blocking takeRequest, and Head.streamContentDecoder identity decoding. HTTP/2 ServerDuplexStream.nextBody pulls DATA, retains trailers for requestTrailers, returns null at END_STREAM, surfaces peer resets as StreamReset and exposes streamContentDecoder. HTTP/2 and HTTP/3 concurrent batch aliases are exposed through netz.streaming. HTTP/3 streaming readers enforce a cumulative Limits.max_body_bytes budget for server requests and for client response/push bodies, counting already-read DATA so a later frame cannot reset it; exceeding the budget surfaces error.PayloadTooLarge at the next read boundary. `serveConcurrentStreams` on HTTP/2 Connection and HTTP/3 HandshakeServerSession accepts streams continuously, runs one handler task per stream up to max_streams, serializes body reads and response head/DATA/trailers/reset through the connection owner, supports streaming responses and response trailers, and stops on shutdown/deadline/idle timeout with GOAWAY.
